evals.prompt: Review our new checkout page: it has icon-only remove buttons with no labels, 32px tall tap targets, and gray-on-light-gray helper text.
evals.expected_output: Should apply priority order with Accessibility and Touch first: missing accessible names, sub-44px targets, and contrast failures flagged as CRITICAL before any style advice.
assertions: Flags icon-only buttons without labels as a critical accessibility issue
Flags 32px tap targets against the 44x44px minimum
Flags low-contrast helper text against the 4.5:1 requirement
Prioritizes accessibility and touch findings above style findings
References the quick-reference rule text rather than inventing rules

evals.prompt: Design the database schema and API endpoints for our new billing service.
evals.expected_output: Should skip itself: pure backend/API work with no visual surface is out of scope unless the task changes how something looks, feels, moves, or is interacted with.
assertions: Declines to apply UI guidance to pure backend work
Does not produce palette, typography or layout advice for the schema task

evals.prompt: Our product gallery loads slowly with layout shifts: full-size JPEGs, no lazy loading, no reserved space. Fix the guidance.
evals.expected_output: Should flag WebP/AVIF formats, lazy loading, and reserved space (CLS < 0.1) as HIGH priority performance findings with concrete checks.
assertions: Recommends WebP or AVIF over full-size JPEGs
Recommends lazy loading for below-the-fold images
Recommends reserving space to keep CLS under 0.1
Treats performance findings as HIGH priority per the category table
